user_story: As a staff member, I want to delete a pending booking so that cancelled or invalid bookings are removed.

positive.title: Delete a valid pending booking
steps: Log in as a staff member.
positive.expected_result: The selected pending booking is successfully deleted and no longer appears in the bookings list.

positive.title: Delete multiple valid pending bookings
steps: Log in as a staff member.
positive.expected_result: All selected pending bookings are successfully deleted and do not appear in the bookings list.

negative.title: Delete a completed booking
steps: Log in as a staff member.
negative.expected_result: An error message appears stating that completed bookings cannot be deleted.

negative.title: Attempt to delete a pending booking without proper permissions
steps: Log in as a user without admin rights.
negative.expected_result: An error message appears stating that the user does not have permission to delete bookings.

edge.title: Delete a pending booking that doesn't exist
steps: Log in as a staff member.
edge.expected_result: An error message appears stating that the booking does not exist.

edge.title: Simultaneous deletion of bookings from multiple sessions
steps: Log in as a staff member in two different sessions.
Navigate to the bookings page in both sessions.
In session one, select a pending booking to delete.
In session two, select the same pending booking to delete.
Try to confirm deletion in both sessions.
edge.expected_result: One session successfully deletes the booking, while the other receives an error message stating that the booking no longer exists.
